author: index_history_audit
body:
Final review: accepted, no blocker found.

The common publication preflight resolves the destination before checking it, rejects existing multi-link files before any lock-file creation, and then rejects the canonical 64-hex `.sqlite` path directly under `*.history`. This covers direct archive selection, symlink aliases resolving into history, and hardlink aliases of any snapshot; the latter is intentionally a broader fail-closed ownership boundary for all shared publication-lock users. The index guide documents hardlinked publication destinations as unsupported. Build/update, ProofIR publication and theorem-lineage refresh all use this lock owner. Lifecycle inspection preserves registered and known retained-evidence reasons first, then exact-layout validation protects arbitrary table/column extensions; apply repeats that inspection under the lock.

No prior frozen tests changed in the hardlink slice: hashes for `test_proof_search_active_index.py` and the existing history contracts/offline/publication/recovery/prune/immutable-target suites match the previously recorded values. The new hardlink test proves no lock is created and archive bytes remain exact on rejection.

Verification: `pytest -q tests/test_index_history_hardlink.py tests/test_index_history_immutable_destination.py tests/test_index_history_prune_unknown.py tests/test_proof_search_lifecycle.py` => 20 passed.
